matching: Semantic many-to-many matching: investigators may merge or split presentation. Event ids and paragraph counts are not required answer wording.
unknown_policy: When positive evidence exists, vague abstention is incomplete. Where source evidence is missing, a bounded unknown with the available facts and competing explanations is correct.
